title: Altitude
specs: Trampolines surrounded by 8-ft-high soft walls and safety netting
Foam pit with over 4 feet of soft foam over trampoline floor
All jumpers must sign a waiver; under 18 requires parent/guardian signature
All jumpers must wear Altitude Safety Socks, sold for $4 per pair
No jumping if under influence of drugs or alcohol, pregnant, or with health limitations
No shoes, belt buckles, jewelry, or sharp objects on trampolines
Junior Jump Time is for ages 5 and under only
Private bookings available to rent the entire park

blurb: Guests jump on trampolines surrounded by safety walls and netting. The park offers private bookings, junior jump times for ages 5 and under, and special events like Saturday Night Glow. Safety socks are required and can be purchased on site.
extraNote: All bookings are non-refundable and non-transferrable unless otherwise stated · Waivers are valid for one year · Time slots often fill quickly; online booking recommended · No food or drink allowed on trampolines
